timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Twenty years ago today, Taylor Swift released her debut album, Taylor Swift, the record that made her a rising star in country music.

timely.label: TV Tonight
timely.line: Reba McEntire's NBC sitcom Happy's Place returns for season three, with Reba running her late father's Tennessee tavern alongside her old co-star Melissa Peterman.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: Wildwood, a new family fantasy film with Mahershala Ali and Angela Bassett, follows a girl into a secret enchanted forest to save her baby brother.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is hosting a prescribed burn field day in Dade County on Oct. 27, and you must finish an online portion before attending.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Trails at the Runge Conservation Nature Center in Jefferson City close Nov. 6 through 8 for a managed archery deer hunt, though the building stays open.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Wired2Fish says the Gamakatsu 4/0 extra wide gap hook may be the best bass hook ever, because it works for dozens of rigs, including soft plastics.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes has a cheap, easy apple spice cake packed with fresh apples, warm spices and nutty brown butter for fall weekends.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's easy one-pan chicken curry uses chicken thighs, potatoes, coconut milk, tomatoes and warm spices, a weeknight dinner the whole family can share.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Pumpkin cornbread muffins sweetened with maple syrup and a touch of pumpkin spice work for breakfast and again warm next to a bowl of chili.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Forecasters now say mortgage rates will not drop until 2028, so anyone counting on refinancing next year may need a new plan.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Mike Rowe says for every five tradespeople who leave, only two are replaced, so it pays to handle home repairs before the first freeze brings a rush of calls.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster says a tablespoon of blackstrap molasses and a pinch of salt in a water bottle is a cheap swap for store-bought hydration packets.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster is choosing the non-smart version of things on purpose, like a regular doorbell, paper notes and a microwave with a dial, to keep life simple.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad told his kid the moon is a potato, got shot down, then asked a stranger on the street, who backed him up immediately.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad is proudly explaining to his daughter that an exasperated eye roll counts just as much as a laugh when it comes to dad jokes.
